chunks: It is indeed an evil halt and an evil abode;

key_terms.مُسْتَقَرّاً: a permanent resting place or dwelling
key_terms.مُقَاماً: a place of stay or abode

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran describe as the evil abode for disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Furqan (25:28) highlights the spiritual and physical degradation of the disbelievers, emphasizing that their 'bad resting place' (muqarr) refers not only to Hell but also to the intermediate realm (Barzakh) where they await judgment. The term 'muqam' (dwelling) underscores the permanence of their state, reflecting the Shia view that rejection of divine guidance leads to an inherent, lasting alienation from God's mercy.
